help.headAll: You see every team. Choose below what each manager handles: they will only see those tabs.
help.headMine: You see your team: your agents and yourself.
help.depot: Parcels at each warehouse step, right now, and what left during the period.
help.suivi: Parcels at delivery companies and couriers: alerts to handle, delivered and returned in the period.
help.sav: After-sales tickets: waiting, in progress, and settled in the period.
help.received: Orders created during the period and assigned to the team's agents. Below: those still in a to-call status (new, to check, no answer, busy, callback, postponed).
help.confirmed: Confirmed orders (or confirmed without stock) among the orders of the first box. Below: every confirmation made in the period, including older orders.
help.confRate: Rate: confirmed ÷ all orders. Red under 50 %, yellow 50–59 %, green from 60 %. Below: cancelled, fake (fake order or wrong number) and duplicate orders.
help.confRatePerf: Performance: confirmed ÷ orders, without duplicates or wrong numbers, only on orders with a known outcome (or older than 15 days). Red under 50 %, yellow 50–59 %, green from 60 %.
help.delivRate: Rate: delivered ÷ confirmed, every confirmed order.
help.inProgress: The team's orders still to call right now: new, to check, no answer, busy, callback, postponed. A number for today, it does not change with the period. Below: new orders of the whole shop without an agent yet.
help.late: “Callback” or “Postponed” orders whose callback time has passed without a new call. Counted now, not over the period.
help.first: Share of orders called for the first time before their deadline. The clock starts at the first assignment to an agent. Last in, first called: the most recent has 15 min, each older one 5 more minutes per more recent order ahead. Night orders (after 9 pm) count from 9 am. Red under 70 %, yellow 70–79 %, green from 80 %. Below: the median delay between assignment and the first call.
help.tries: After “no answer” or “busy”, the next try must be made in the next slot: morning 9–12, midday 12–16, evening 16–21 (after the evening, next morning). 3 tries at most. Share of tries made on time, counted for the agent who made the unanswered call. Red under 70 %, yellow 70–79 %, green from 80 %.
help.calls: Every confirmation status change made by an agent in the period counts as a call. Below: how many calls per confirmation on average.

teams.title: Confirmation teams
teams.how: Creation date: orders received in the period. Status change date: orders handled in the period (their last status of the period, credited to the agent who set it). “Rate”: business numbers on every order (confirmation = confirmed ÷ orders, delivery = delivered ÷ confirmed, final = delivered ÷ orders). “Performance”: the same rates to judge agents, without duplicates or wrong numbers, only on orders with a known outcome (or older than 15 days). One call = one status change by the agent. On a single day, the chart is hour by hour.

cmp.help: Teams side by side over the period. Rate = confirmed ÷ orders; Performance = the same rate without duplicates or wrong numbers, on orders with a known outcome.

confirmation.confRate: Listen to a few calls together: present the offer clearly, reassure about cash on delivery and answer price objections (delivery fee, competitor).
confirmation.deliveryRate: Before confirming, check the address and the commune, and that the customer really expects the parcel: a confirmed order that comes back costs the fees twice.
confirmation.firstRate: Call every new order within its slot: a customer called fast confirms far more often. Start the day with the new orders.
confirmation.triesRate: Call the “no answer” again in the next slot, without missing one: the 2nd and 3rd tries win back many orders.
confirmation.upsellRate: Offer the pack or the matching product on every call: a ready-made sentence helps a lot.

suivi.deliveryRate: Call the customer as soon as the parcel leaves and the day before delivery: a customer who knows is home, with the money.
suivi.treatMs: Handle alerts within the hour: call the customer, then pass the solution to the company (new date, address, stop desk).
suivi.savedRate: After an alert, offer a concrete solution (new date, office, other number) before the parcel goes back.

depot.prepMs: Every day, pack the orders confirmed the day before, oldest first.
depot.prep24Rate: Never leave a confirmed order more than 24 h: pack in order of arrival and report a missing stock at once.
depot.wrongRate: Check every product before closing the parcel: variant, size, colour and condition. Scan when possible.

livreurs.deliveryRate: Call the customer before going and confirm the address: fewer wasted trips, fewer returns.
livreurs.lateRate: Never keep a parcel more than 2 days: deliver it, or bring it back to the depot to find another solution.

sav.settleMs: Call the customer back the same day and start the exchange or refund without waiting.
sav.settled48Rate: Settle every ticket within 48 h: handle the oldest first.
sav.satRate: Call after the exchange to check the customer is happy, and write down what is wrong.
